title: The Consecration of the Trumpets and the Departure from Sinai
description: The Lord gives Moses instructions to make two silver trumpets for calling the assembly and signaling the camps to break camp. In the second year, the cloud lifts from the tabernacle, and the Israelites set out from the wilderness of Sinai toward the wilderness of Paran in a fixed order, tribe by tribe. Moses asks his brother-in-law Hobab to join them as a guide, and when the ark set out, Moses said: "Rise up, Lord! May your enemies be scattered."
